desc.zh: 逐步解析表达式，观察变量如何遮蔽与恢复。
desc.en: Parse expressions and watch variable bindings hide and restore.

complexity: O(n) expected time; O(n) auxiliary space, n = expression character length

concepts.name: Lexical scope
concepts.description: Track per-name binding stacks and restore outer values.

concepts.name: Recursive descent
concepts.description: Consume exactly one expression per recursive call.
